# Chart Legend

```tsx
import { ChartLegend, ChartLegendSwatch, chartColor, chartTypeOptions, formatChartTypedValue, formatChartValue, typedChartNumber } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Chart Legend, shared by the charts: Inline wraps its items and List stacks them, with the values on the right. An item with no `color` is the Figma Color=None: no swatch, as in the total row of the Chart Bar.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ChartLegendProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `format?` | `"inline" \| "list"` | Figma Format. |

## Types

`ChartColor`, `ChartLegendItem`, `ChartLegendProps`, `ChartValueType`

## Rules

- Import `ChartLegend` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
